final_holdout.q: Root Complex 的 Read Completion Boundary 可以是多大？
final_holdout.e: For a Root Complex, RCB is 64 bytes or 128 bytes

final_holdout.q: Max_Read_Request_Size 限制的是 Requester 的什么行为？
final_holdout.e: The Function must not generate Read Requests with a size exceeding the set value

final_holdout.q: 启用 ARI 后一个 Device 最多能有多少 Functions？
final_holdout.e: Each ARI Device may contain up to 256 Functions

final_holdout.q: 不使用 ARI 的 Device 最多包含几个 Functions？
final_holdout.e: Each non-ARI Device may contain up to eight Functions

final_holdout.q: ARI 怎么重新解释 Device Number 和 Function Number？
final_holdout.e: the Device Number field is eliminated

final_holdout.q: LTSSM 的 timeout values 默认允许多大误差？
final_holdout.e: minus 0 seconds and plus 50% unless explicitly stated otherwise

final_holdout.q: SR-IOV 的 VF Power States 会改变 Link Power State 吗？
final_holdout.e: VF Power States do not affect the Link Power State

final_holdout.q: Group I 的 outstanding Non-Posted Requests，Transaction ID 是否必须唯一？
final_holdout.e: Transaction ID values are unique for all outstanding Non-Posted Requests in Group I

final_holdout.q: Memory Read Completion 的 Byte Count 全为 0 表示多少 bytes？
1b/1b encoding 接收端可以一次插入或删除几个 Bytes 的 SKP？
final_holdout.e: each Receiver is permitted to insert or delete 8 Bytes of SKP

final_holdout.q: 一次 Link speed negotiation 失败后，再尝试该速度之前要等多久？
final_holdout.e: until 200 ms has passed from the return to L0 following the failed attempt

final_holdout.q: Target Link Speed 字段对 Link speed 施加什么限制？
final_holdout.e: The Target Link Speed field in the Link Control 2 register in the Downstream Port sets the upper bound for the Link speed
